Yuno Fast-Tracks Merchant Access to Revolut Payment Stack
summary:
Merchants can now use one Yuno connection to add Revolut’s biometric one-click checkout, Revolut Pay, as well as Revolut’s acquiring and gateway services, Yuno said in a Thursday (Sept. 3) press release. The offering is enabled by a new partnership of Yuno and Revolut Business, according to the release. The partnership integrates Revolut’s full payment […]
The post Yuno Fast-Tracks Merchant Access to Revolut Payment Stack appeared first on PYMNTS.com.
content: Yuno has partnered with Revolut Business to accelerate merchant access to the Revolut payment stack. Through this integration, merchants can utilize a single Yuno connection to incorporate Revolut’s acquiring services, gateway solutions, and the biometric one-click checkout feature known as Revolut Pay. The collaboration aims to streamline payment processing capabilities for businesses by simplifying the implementation of these specific Revolut financial tools via the Yuno platform.

title: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman critiques industry power dynamics, calls fear-based AI messaging ‘fundamentally anti-human’
summary:
Altman's critique highlights the risk of centralizing AI power, urging a shift towards empowering individuals and fostering entrepreneurship.
The post OpenAI CEO Sam Altman critiques industry power dynamics, calls fear-based AI messaging ‘fundamentally anti-human’ appeared first on Crypto Briefing.
content: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman has criticized current industry power dynamics and dismissed fear-based artificial intelligence messaging as fundamentally anti-human. His perspective emphasizes the importance of avoiding the centralization of artificial intelligence power, instead encouraging a strategic shift toward empowering individuals and supporting broader entrepreneurship within the technology sector.

title: Robinhood Chain keeps blocks flowing despite 14-minute blob gap on Ethereum
summary:
The incident highlights the vulnerability of single-sequencer systems under high transaction loads, raising concerns about future scalability.
The post Robinhood Chain keeps blocks flowing despite 14-minute blob gap on Ethereum appeared first on Crypto Briefing.
content: Robinhood Chain successfully maintained block production during a recent technical disruption on Ethereum. The network experienced a fourteen-minute gap in blob availability, yet the system remained operational. This incident underscores the inherent risks associated with single-sequencer architectures when subjected to significant transaction volume, prompting broader industry discussions regarding the long-term scalability and stability of such blockchain infrastructure moving forward.

title: Perplexity builds custom serving infrastructure to make AI search faster and cheaper
summary:

The post Perplexity builds custom serving infrastructure to make AI search faster and cheaper appeared first on Crypto Briefing.
content: Perplexity has announced the development of custom serving infrastructure designed to optimize its AI-powered search capabilities. By transitioning away from reliance on third-party providers, the company aims to enhance processing speeds and significantly reduce operational expenses. This strategic shift is expected to improve the efficiency and scalability of its platform, allowing for more performant large-scale AI deployments while maintaining a competitive advantage in the rapidly evolving search landscape.

title: David Tepper sells 41% of Micron shares, and it’s still his second-largest holding
summary:
Tepper's strategic shift highlights evolving semiconductor market dynamics, with implications for future investment trends and AI infrastructure growth.
The post David Tepper sells 41% of Micron shares, and it’s still his second-largest holding appeared first on Crypto Briefing.
content: Investment firm Appaloosa Management, led by David Tepper, has significantly reduced its stake in Micron Technology. Despite selling 41% of its shares, Micron remains the second-largest position within the firm’s portfolio. This strategic adjustment reflects changing market sentiment regarding semiconductor equities and the broader hardware infrastructure landscape as investors rebalance their holdings in response to shifting industry performance and market conditions.

summary:

content: GitHub has introduced a new AI coding router designed to optimize model selection for software development. By leveraging advanced routing technology, the platform aims to deliver frontier-level quality and improved efficiency for developers. This strategic move could impact the broader AI coding landscape, prompting competitors to either enhance their own model performance or reassess their service costs to remain competitive in an increasingly automated software engineering market.
